description.value: Dosa Crepe Cafe is a South Indian fusion restaurant that blends traditional fermented-rice dosa with French crepe techniques, serving an extensive menu of dosas, curries, biriyani, bubble tea, and alcoholic beverages. The Rutland location is one of four BC outposts, and the restaurant takes reservations for groups of 4–12 while remaining walk-in friendly for solo cyclists. The menu is notably inclusive, with gluten-free and vegan options throughout.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Rutland branch at No.110, Gray Road, Kelowna, BC V1X1W7, with dine-in, takeout, and delivery. Gluten-free and vegan claims are explicitly stated on the About Us page ('Our Dosa is gluten free, vegan'). No bike parking, washrooms, or Wi-Fi are mentioned anywhere on the site. There are minor inconsistencies in contact details across website pages (phone shown as 877-452-0733 on About Us/Franchise pages vs. 778-753-6939 on Contacts/Locations pages; Rutland email varies between orderdosacrepe@gmail.com and orderdosa2@gmail.com across pages).
concerns: Phone number inconsistency within website: Contacts and Locations pages show 778-753-6939 (matches OSM), but About Us and Franchise pages list 877-452-0733 for the Rutland branch — likely a typo (877 vs 778) but worth verifying.

Email inconsistency: OSM lists orderdosa2@gmail.com for Rutland, which matches the Locations page, but the Contacts page assigns orderdosa2@gmail.com to the Downtown Kelowna branch and lists orderdosacrepe@gmail.com for Rutland. Branch emails appear to be confused or duplicated across pages.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active dine-in and takeout restaurant with confirmed address, operating website, and multiple BC locations. A useful stop for touring cyclists seeking a full meal with vegan and gluten-free options.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: About Us page states: 'Our Dosa is gluten free, vegan and uses the freshest ingredients available.' Menu page also describes dosa as 'a gluten free vegan crepe'
